scope: Matched direct versus experimental force-grid orbit comparison.
statistics_scope: All 50,000 samples; raw intrinsic normalized histograms/moments, before spatial symmetries, counter-rotation, or observational projection.
timing_scope: Fresh synchronized whole solves, including 50000 saved samples and batched direct physical-energy diagnostics. Lowering/compilation, first compiled execution and warm repeats are separate. Grid build costs come from the identified force experiment; table loading and transfer are measured here. Statistics and I/O are excluded from solve timings. Break-even is warm construction cost divided by warm time saved for identical repeated launches, excluding compiler cost and statistical acceptance; it is not library throughput.
physical_energy: Unchanged direct potential, not an interpolated scalar.
